title: P15.9-B3: /app/objectives* — objective list, detail & reviews on canonical cockpit reads
description: R3 residual fix on B3. R3-F1: ObjectiveList creation now holds ONE dedup_key per logical attempt (attemptKey+attemptTerms refs) — an identical retry after a lost/ambiguous response reuses the same key and canonical terms so ObjectiveAuthorityService's exact-create replay converges to the same objective_id; the key rotates only when request terms change (deliberate new operation) and resets after confirmed canonical success or business switch; ConfirmDialog flow, biz isolation and prior R1/R2 guards unchanged. Adversarial e2e: real UI submit → backend commits → response poisoned to 502 → identical retry → both POSTs carry the SAME dedup_key → replay returns the SAME objective_id → business company shows exactly 1 objective → deliberate new creation gets a fresh key. Zero backend/deps. Proof: tsc+vite PASS; playwright 52/52 (objectives 20 + company 10 + app 12 + smoke 5 + chat 5) on real :8790.
